model: Stage Series C1 (SSC1) Sport LED pod, white, standard mount, pair (DD6450P spot / DD6445P flood / DD6440P wide)
price_note: Diode Dynamics store, pair, all beam options same price

specs.mass_g_basis: product page unit weight 0.34 lb (154 g) per pod; the info guide says 0.7 lb single / 1.2 lb pair (likely packed)
specs.dimensions_axes: per pod: L = 50.8 (2.0 in) wide, W = 61 (2.4 in) deep front-to-back incl. fins and connector, H = 66 (2.6 in) tall incl. bracket; pod head 2.0 x 2.0 in
specs.mounting: Per pod: L-bracket foot 1.1 x 1.1 in (28 x 28 mm) with one 5/16-18 x 3/4 in bolt to the chassis; the pod pivots on a 10-32 x 1-3/8 in cross bolt (tilt adjust). Pivot axis 0.8 in (20 mm) above the foot. A flush-mount kit and GoPro-style adapter exist.
specs.mounting_basis: info guide PP0140H hardware list and drawing
specs.power_note: 12.8 W main beam per pod (1.0 A @ 12.8 V) + 0.3 W backlight; pair 25.6 W / 2.0 A
specs.beam: spot 50,000 cd (DD6450P); flood 400 cd; wide 2,500 cd
specs.connector: integrated Deutsch DT 4-pin (main, ground, backlight, brake) with short pigtail; 18 AWG or larger
specs.orientation_cooling: Finned die-cast aluminium back: keep the fins in free air; aim forward; 12.8 W each heats the housing.

notes: Proposed real replacement for assumed-led-pod-pair-20w: a small (2 in), well-documented 12 V pod from a US maker. 9-16 V input fits the 12 V rail. Power warning: the pair draws 25.6 W, and with the VLP-16 (8 W typ, 3 A spin-up surge) that exceeds the DDR-30L-12's 30 W/2.5 A; either PWM-dim the lights (low-side MOSFET) or move them/the lidar to a bigger 12 V supply. Cheaper generic 2 in pods (Nilight/Auxbeam, ~$25/pair) publish no reliable dims or mass.
